_comment: Multi-table extract config: one block per distinct FD rate table on hdfc.bank.in/fixed-deposit/fd-interest-rate. Mirrors what lib/templating/llm_propose.js produces. table_index is source-order DOM index. idx=0 = retail <3Cr (header band spans 2 rows), idx=2 = bulk >=3Cr to <5Cr. idx=1 is a desktop/mobile duplicate of idx=0 and is intentionally not mapped.
